nodes.name: prime_toggle_square_quotient_divides
nodes.summary: Cancel one actual nonzero factor in a witnessed square divisor; the quotient is genuinely divisible by p.

nodes.name: prime_toggle_fresh_divisor_product
nodes.summary: A prime divisor of n not dividing d can be adjoined to an actual divisor d: Euclid cancellation constructs the required quotient.

nodes.name: prime_factor_toggle_exists
nodes.summary: Two constructive divisibility decisions supply the added factor, a genuine quotient, or a fixed prime-square multiple.

nodes.name: prime_factor_toggle_functional
nodes.summary: Fresh, singly divisible and square-divisible branches are disjoint; cancellation of a nonzero p proves exact output uniqueness.

nodes.name: prime_factor_toggle_symmetric
nodes.summary: Adding and removing a fresh factor reverse each other, while the witnessed square-divisible branch is fixed.

nodes.name: prime_factor_toggle_positive
nodes.summary: Every raw toggle of a positive input by a nonzero p remains positive, including the quotient branch.

nodes.name: prime_factor_toggle_preserves_divisor
nodes.summary: Every actual prime toggle of a divisor of n is again a divisor, provided p itself is a prime divisor of n.

nodes.name: divisor_prime_toggle_exists
nodes.summary: Decide positive-divisor membership and construct the raw toggle there, using identity at zero and nondivisors.

nodes.name: divisor_prime_toggle_functional
nodes.summary: The actual positive-divisor toggle and omitted-index identity define one output for every natural index.

nodes.name: divisor_prime_toggle_symmetric
nodes.summary: For a prime divisor of positive n, toggling preserves positive divisors and reverses the actual graph; omitted indices stay fixed.

nodes.name: divisor_prime_toggle_bounded
nodes.summary: Every actual prime-toggle image of the finite interval 0..n remains in that interval, not in an assumed larger universe.

nodes.name: divisor_prime_toggle_prefix_exists
nodes.summary: Ordinary finite induction constructs the actual beta-coded prime toggle at every index in the requested window.

nodes.name: divisor_prime_toggle_prefix_lookup
nodes.summary: Every actual decoded output of the constructed finite map obeys the independent positive-divisor toggle graph.

nodes.name: divisor_prime_toggle_prefix_permutation
nodes.summary: The actual S n-entry prime toggle is a bounded, injective and constructively surjective permutation, including all fixed omitted indices.

nodes.name: divisor_prime_toggle_permutation_exists
nodes.summary: For every actual prime divisor of a positive input, construct the complete finite toggle permutation without supplying its code.

nodes.name: mobius_prime_factor_toggle_negates
nodes.summary: Actual prime toggling negates independently defined Möbius values, including fixed nonsquarefree values, which are proved to be zero.

nodes.name: mobius_divisor_mask_actual_value
nodes.summary: Every retained entry of an actual Möbius divisor mask is the independent positive-input Möbius value at that divisor.

nodes.name: mobius_divisor_mask_prime_toggle_negates
nodes.summary: Every pair of actual Möbius-mask values along the finite prime toggle are signed opposites, including zero, nondivisors and squared-prime multiples.

nodes.name: signed_table_swapped_components_negation_at
nodes.summary: Swapping the real positive and negative beta components constructs the exact negated signed lookup, with no canonical-component equality assumption.

nodes.name: signed_prefix_sum_pointwise_negate
nodes.summary: Pointwise opposite canonical signed entries have opposite actual finite sums, by genuine swapped-component folds and representation independence.

nodes.name: anti_invariant_signed_permutation_sum_zero
nodes.summary: A genuine finite signed sum whose actual permutation pullback is pointwise its opposite is zero; ordinary characteristic-zero cancellation is proved, not assumed.

nodes.name: mobius_divisor_mask_prime_factor_sum_zero
nodes.summary: A genuinely constructed prime-toggle permutation makes the actual zero-masked Möbius sum anti-invariant, hence zero; no cancellation formula is an input.

nodes.name: mobius_divisor_sum_nonunit_value_zero
nodes.summary: For every positive nonunit n, construct an actual prime divisor and prove that every genuine Möbius divisor sum is canonical zero.

nodes.name: mobius_divisor_sum_nonunit_zero
nodes.summary: Construct the actual finite divisor sum before identifying it with zero for every positive nonunit input.

nodes.name: mobius_divisor_sum_unit_one
nodes.summary: The unit boundary is the genuine two-entry mask fold 0+mu(1)=+1, whose canonical signed code is two.

nodes.name: mobius_divisor_sum_cancellation
nodes.summary: Full positive-divisor cancellation for independently defined Möbius values: the actual sum is +1 exactly at n=1 and zero at every n>1, with a constructed fold in both directions.

nodes.name: mobius_divisor_sum_cancellation_exists
nodes.summary: For each positive natural, construct the actual Möbius table, its real finite divisor-sum trace and the exact unit/nonunit result; no table or quotient is supplied.

nodes.name: mobius_divisor_sum_cancellation_on_positive_values
nodes.summary: Full Möbius divisor cancellation holds for any actual signed table with the correct positive values, with F(0) entirely unrestricted; positive-source extensionality transports genuine folds.

nodes.name: Le
nodes.summary: Witness-defined non-strict order on natural numbers.

nodes.name: Lt
nodes.summary: Witness-defined strict order on natural numbers.

nodes.name: Dvd
nodes.summary: The natural number d divides n.

nodes.name: Prime
nodes.summary: p is nonunit and every factorization of p has a unit factor.

nodes.name: Coprime
nodes.summary: Every common divisor of a and b is one.

nodes.name: BetaAt
nodes.summary: x is the bounded beta-decoded value at index i.

nodes.name: BoundedPrefix
nodes.summary: Every decoded entry below l is itself below l.

nodes.name: InjectivePrefix
nodes.summary: Equal decoded values below l have equal indices.

nodes.name: MatrixMinorFourCode
nodes.summary: One canonical injective doubled-Cantor code for all four signed-minor beta-code parameters.

nodes.name: SignedDecode
nodes.summary: The original canonical integer code: even 2p denotes p, and odd 2k+1 denotes −(k+1). The decoded positive and negative parts are normalized.

nodes.name: SignedBalance
nodes.summary: The original canonical code z represents the integer difference p−n; these supplied components need not be normalized.

nodes.name: ArithTable
nodes.summary: An actual packed signed table with canonical signed entries through index N, including index zero. It contains no divisor transform or inversion hypothesis.

nodes.name: ArithAt
nodes.summary: Two genuine beta entries of the packed table represent the unique canonical signed value z. Distinct component representations need not be equal.

nodes.name: HasPrimeSquareDivisor
nodes.summary: A genuine prime p and an actual quotient witness p*p dividing n. This is not an asserted factorization oracle.

nodes.name: Squarefree
nodes.summary: Positive n with no squared prime divisor p² for any prime p≤n. The bounded condition is proved to exclude all squared prime divisors.

nodes.name: Product
nodes.summary: z is the product of a beta-coded prefix of length l.

nodes.name: AllPrime
nodes.summary: Every decoded factor below l is prime.

nodes.name: PrimeFactorList
nodes.summary: A positive number n, an actual length-l beta product equal to n, and prime entries. No sortedness or supplied canonicalization is required.

nodes.name: Even
nodes.summary: n has an even decomposition.

nodes.name: Odd
nodes.summary: n has an odd decomposition.

nodes.name: AlternatingSignedUnit
nodes.summary: The actual signed code of (-1)^n from parity: even exponents give code 2 (+1), odd exponents code 1 (-1).

nodes.name: FactorParitySign
nodes.summary: A genuine finite prime-factor list for n has a length whose alternating signed unit is z. Independence of the factor list is proved.

nodes.name: Mobius
nodes.summary: For positive n, an actual prime-square divisor gives signed zero; otherwise squarefreeness and real factor-count parity give the signed unit. No divisor-sum or inversion identity occurs here.

nodes.name: MobiusTable
nodes.summary: A genuine table through N records zero at index zero and the independently defined Möbius value at every positive index through N. The zero-table convention does not extend Mobius to input zero.

nodes.name: DivisorMaskEntry
nodes.summary: A positive d with an actual quotient n=d*q keeps the genuine input value F(d); zero and nondivisors give canonical zero. The zero branch never reads or restricts F(0).

nodes.name: DivisorMask
nodes.summary: An actual signed table through the inclusive bound l satisfies the independent divisor-mask entry graph at every represented index. The construction bound l is independent of n, enabling ordinary finite induction.

nodes.name: Sum
nodes.summary: z is the sum of a beta-coded prefix of length l.

nodes.name: SignedPrefixSum
nodes.summary: The signed balance of two actual natural finite sums, at exactly the indices 0<=i<l. Existence, uniqueness and representation independence are proved separately.

nodes.name: DivisorSum
nodes.summary: For explicitly positive n, construct a genuine mask through n and take its actual signed fold over S n entries. Index zero is masked away; neither divisor cancellation nor Möbius inversion is part of the graph.

nodes.name: SurjectivePrefix
nodes.summary: Every value below l occurs at an index below l.

nodes.name: PermutationPrefix
nodes.summary: An actual beta-coded bijection of the finite index interval [0,l), including all bounds, injectivity, and surjectivity.

nodes.name: ArithReindex
nodes.summary: Actual beta-map lookup pulls each source signed value into the target table below l. Neither permutation bijectivity nor any sum identity is assumed in this graph.

nodes.name: ArithPositiveEqual
nodes.summary: Equality of represented values at precisely 0<d<=N. Values at zero are unrestricted, and raw codes or positive/negative representatives are not asserted equal.

nodes.name: PrimeFactorToggle
nodes.summary: Add a fresh factor p, remove a single factor p with p-free quotient, or fix a multiple of p squared. The graph contains no Möbius sign or cancellation hypothesis.

nodes.name: DivisorPrimeToggle
nodes.summary: Apply the actual prime-factor toggle at positive divisors of n and fix zero and nondivisors. Closure in the divisor set and involutivity are proved under Prime(p), n>0 and Dvd(p,n).

nodes.name: DivisorPrimeTogglePrefix
nodes.summary: A real finite beta map witnesses each divisor-prime-toggle output on i<l. No finite-choice, permutation or sum identity is assumed.

nodes.name: SignedNegate
nodes.summary: Canonical signed negation swaps the positive and negative decoded parts.

nodes.name: ArithNegate
nodes.summary: Every pair of actual represented signed values at the same i<l are opposite. Genuine table validity is a separate hypothesis; arbitrary codes and component streams need not agree.

nodes.name: MobiusPositiveValues
nodes.summary: Every actual positive entry through N agrees with the independently defined Möbius function. Table validity is separate and F(0) is unrestricted; the historical MobiusTable zero convention remains unchanged.
